invite.title: Invite a member
invite.intro: The invitee receives an email with a link to choose their own password. The account name cannot be changed by the invitee.
invite.noTeams: There are no teams to assign.
invite.noRows: No team roles. The member can get roles later.
invite.emailAddressInUse: This email address is already in use by a member or another invitation.
invite.accountNameTaken: This sign-in name is already taken by a member or another invitation.
invite.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
invite.rateLimitedWait: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

accept.title: Accept your invitation
accept.intro: You are invited to join {{clubName}}. Choose a password for your account.
accept.invalid: This invitation cannot be used. Contact your club for help.
accept.done: Your account is ready. Sign in with your sign-in name and your new password.
accept.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
accept.rateLimitedUnknown: Too many requests. Try again later.

problem.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
problem.policy: This password does not meet the password requirements. Choose another one; your invitation is still valid.
problem.refused: The platform refused this password. Choose another one.
problem.unreachable: The platform is not reachable. Try again in a moment.
problem.error: Something went wrong. Try again later.

list.title: Invitations
list.resent: A new invitation was sent to {{address}}. The previous link no longer works.
list.revokeText: The link in the invitation to {{address}} stops working, and the sign-in name and email address become available again.
list.notOpen: This invitation was already accepted or revoked. The list was refreshed.
list.stale: This invitation was changed in the meantime. The list was refreshed.
list.rateLimited: Too many resends. Try again later.
list.rateLimitedWait: Too many resends. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
